item.text: The view renders results in reverse order, and each result already has a timeline and a direct match index. I’ll merge adjacent timelines in that display order, then use each matched event’s own ID for its tile link.

The view now accumulates overlapping results and renders the tile only when the chain ends. I’ve also changed the tile to highlight only the recorded match indices and to build each match link from that event’s ID. I’ll add a regression test for a three-result chain.
The regression case covers three linked results followed by a separate result. Jest and the type check are still running; once they finish, I’ll address any failures and check formatting.

Room search now merges adjacent results whose timelines share a boundary event. [RoomSearchView.tsx](/app/src/components/structures/RoomSearchView.tsx) skips the duplicate event and records each direct match’s index; [SearchResultTile.tsx](/app/src/components/views/rooms/SearchResultTile.tsx) uses those indices for highlighting and links each match to its own event ID.
